author: Bobby Grayson
description: Sequential chroniclers avoided database contention; parallel writers would need per-worktree records plus deciduous sync. The harness's own worktree isolation was unusable because the session predates git init; plain git worktrees created by the agents worked.
title: Deciduous worked as the inter-agent channel: chroniclers wrote each piece's options/decisions under the root, the integrator read them before resolving the translator conflict between crash (clause ordering) and receive (defer clause), and the verifier audited the tree. Quirk: read-only deciduous commands rewrite the sqlite file, which dirties git status
